name: Japanese Vegetable Sushi Bowl
ingredients: ¾ cup cooked short-grain brown rice, cooled
150 g firm tofu or ¾ cup shelled edamame
1 tsp rice vinegar (no added sugar), mixed through the rice
Dressing: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp oil
steps: Toss the cooled rice with the rice vinegar.
If using tofu, marinate it in 1 tsp soy sauce, then pan-sear until golden. Cook edamame for 4 minutes if using.
Divide the rice between two bowls and arrange the tofu or edamame, cucumber, carrot and avocado on top.
Scatter with nori, pickled ginger and spring onion and drizzle with dressing.
note: A deconstructed sushi roll without raw fish or sugary rice seasoning.
